messages:
eli: noticing a weird gap 11 PD shows 3 active incidents for inference-latency but nobody oncall was paged. did the paging integration break?
ops-bot: alert: webhook_delivery_failures detected for integration 'pagerflow' (violations: 4 in last 5m). sample error: 403 invalid_signature, 502 bad_gateway. delivery ids: d_998,d_999,d_1000.
natalie: i'm pulling delivery logs now. can someone confirm whether incident-bot recently had a secret rotation? last deploy of infra-secrets was ~13:58 UTC.
tom: CI ran secrets/rotate-kms on the infra stack at 13:56 (automated rotation per policy). i pushed the rotation but left consumer rollout to be in-place to avoid a blast radius. maybe we need to force consumers to reload.
incident-bot: system message: started run loop at 14:03 UTC; using token mounted at /etc/secrets/pagerflow_token (mtime 2026-02-28T13:55:22Z). signature header generated for delivery: X-Signature: sha256=abce...
eli: can someone attempt a manual send to the PD webhook to reproduce?
ton: quick test from bastion: ```bash
http --verbose POST https://hooks.pagerflow.internal/v1/events Authorization:"Bearer $CUR_TOKEN" incident='\{"title\":\"test\"}'
* Connected to hooks.pagerflow.internal (10.20.30.40) port 443 (#0)
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< {"error":"invalid_signature","expected":"sha256=xyz...","actual":"sha256=abce..."}
```
eli: that lines up. the signature our client sends doesn't match server expected signature. if KMS rotated the signing key, consumer needs new signer.
natalie: checking KMS key versions... KMS: pagerflow-signing-key rotated at 13:56 -> new version v3. consumers must fetch new public key. looks like incident-bot is still signing with v2.
oncall-rotation: we got an oncall page at 14:06 via manual escalation (sms) from support. :warning: but no PD page. we had to manually create an incident to get primary aware.
incident-bot: debug: current key path /etc/secrets/pagerflow_pub.pem contains fingerprint f1a2; expected f2b3 for v3.
tom: short-term mitigation: we can restart incident-bot after updating the mounted secret to v3. longer-term we should implement a hot-reload for mounted keys, or query KMS on miss.
eli: i'm going to create a quick patch: try to add a liveness check that fails if webhook deliveries return 4xx/5xx more than 3x in 2m, which will trigger restart via k8s pod autorestart policy while we push a proper fix.
natalie: i updated the secret in the secret-store to point to v3 and kicked a rolling restart: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/incident-bot`
ops-bot: deploy: rollout status deploy/incident-bot: 2/2 updated, 2/2 ready (14:22 UTC).
ton: retest after restart: ```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW_TOKEN" -XPOST https://hooks.pagerflow.internal/v1/events -d '{"incident":"smoke"}' -i
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"accepted","delivery_id":"d_1001"}
```
oncall-rotation: got the page at 14:24 and acknowledged at 14:26. primary oncall confirmed.
pagerflow-bot: system message: delivery_metrics: pre-mitigation failures: 6; post-mitigation successes: 12; mean delivery lag: 1.8s. last failure reason: signature_mismatch -> resolved.
eli: customer impact summary: brief spike in 5xx rates for inference endpoints between 13:59-14:25 UTC. support opened 6 tickets; two enterprise customers reported user-facing errors that required retries. impact appears bounded but we need a proper postmortem.
statusbot: posting draft status update to status.redwood.ai: "Between 13:59-14:24 UTC we experienced degraded notification delivery to our paging provider due to a signing key mismatch after a scheduled KMS rotation. Paging resumed after a rolling restart of incident-bot. Some customers experienced transient errors; we are investigating and will follow up with a postmortem."
eli: action items captured: INF-3502 (ensure consumers hot-reload signing keys / fallback signing verification), INF-3503 (add liveness & webhook delivery healthcheck + alert), PM-1300 (status page incident writeup). assign owners and due dates.
tom: I'll open INF-3502 and add an optional KMS pubkey fetch on 401/403 to self-heal within 30s. also propose adding a canary that verifies signature acceptance on rotation.
natalie: add runbook step: when rotating signing keys, push updated secret to consumer mount and perform smoke deliveries to PD; if smoke fails, escalate to oncall-sre and consider temporary rollback of rotation.
oncall-rotation: recommend adding SMS fallback path to the incident-bot runbook if webhook deliveries to primary provider fail for >2m.
eli: thanks everyone. i'll convert this thread into the postmortem skeleton and link INF-3502/3503 to it. closing thread after PM confirms postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
